lines.en: label halloweentwo8:
scene otohadoubledate1
: Hey. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 嗨。怎么了？

lines.en: : Hey. You should date Futaba.
lines.zh: : 嗨。你应该跟 Futaba 交往。

lines.en: : What are you doing?!
lines.zh: : 你在干什么啊？！

lines.en: : Yeah, what are you doing? You’re supposed to be the one who doesn’t want me to do anything like that.
lines.zh: : 对啊，你在干什么？你应该是那个不希望我做这种事的人吧。

lines.en: : Remember your job here, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 记住你的职责啊，Otoha。

lines.en: : I don’t mean like date date, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我当然不是字面意义上那种交往。

lines.en: : You want me to just use her and then dump her? What kind of friend are you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我把她玩了再甩掉？你算哪门子朋友？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate2
: She’s talking about a double-date, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 她说的是双重约会啦，Sensei。

lines.en: : Nodoka has coordinated a spontaneous game of truth or dare in the corner of the room and Futaba doesn’t want to go because she gets nervous with stuff like that.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 在房间角落组织了一场临时起意的真心话大冒险，Futaba 不想去，因为那种事会让她紧张。

lines.en: : Sensei...please just...ignore this conversation and go back to the other table...
lines.zh: : Sensei……拜托你……就当没听见这段对话，回那张桌子去吧……

lines.en: : I can’t. I already had a cool and memorable send-off.
lines.zh: : 不行。我刚刚已经完成了一个又酷又难忘的告别。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I'm just trying to make this a double date.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我只是想把这弄成一场双重约会。

lines.en: : But like...I mean, if you want to date Futaba like, for real, you probably should.
lines.zh: : 不过话又说回来……我是说，如果你真想认真地跟 Futaba 交往，那你大概确实该那么做。

lines.en: : Again, remember your role here.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，记住你的角色。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate3
: No, no. Think about it. Futaba’s not only more mature than pretty much everybody in our class, but she’s also more developed than everybody in our class.
lines.zh: : 不不。你仔细想想。Futaba 不只是比我们班上几乎所有人都成熟，她发育得也比全班所有人都好。

lines.en: : It’d be just like dating a real, live adult woman! Do you think you’d be okay with that?
lines.zh: : 那就跟跟一个活生生的成年女人交往没两样了！你觉得你能接受吗？

lines.en: : I’m so sorry...
lines.zh: : 我真是太抱歉了……

lines.en: : There’s no reason to apologize. I’m fine with being your temporary date for the night.
lines.zh: : 没什么好道歉的。我很乐意当你今晚的临时约会对象。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate4
: What? No, I...Come on.
lines.zh: : 什么？不，我……拜托。

lines.en: : I don’t see the big deal. Everyone else will just think I’m sitting at the table like I normally would.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这有什么大不了的。其他人只会以为我跟平常一样坐在桌边而已。

lines.en: : But what they won’t know is that I’m secretly your temporary boyfriend...Frank.
lines.zh: : 但他们不会知道的是，我其实是你的秘密临时男友……Frank。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate5
: Frank?
lines.zh: : Frank？

lines.en: : Why are you Frank? I don’t want to date Frank. I don’t even know Frank.
lines.zh: : 你为什么是 Frank？我不想跟 Frank 交往。我根本不认识 Frank。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. If you’re Frank, we should give Futaba a codename as well.
lines.zh: : 好好好。既然你是 Frank，那我们也该给 Futaba 起个代号。

lines.en: : If this is how dating works, I think I’m okay with just...not ever doing that.
lines.zh: : 如果约会就是这么回事的话，我觉得我……还是一辈子都不约会好了。

lines.en: : Futaba can be Clarissa- a single mother of three who works nights at a local hostess club.
lines.zh: : Futaba 可以叫 Clarissa——一个带着三个孩子的单亲妈妈，晚上在当地的陪酒俱乐部上班。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate6
: What is happening?! Why do I have kids now?!
lines.zh: : 这都什么跟什么？！我怎么突然就有孩子了？！

lines.en: : I wanna be Jazmin, the badass leader of an underground fight club! But not like, secret underground. Literally underground.
lines.zh: : 我要当 Jazmin，一个地下搏击俱乐部的超猛老大！但不是那种秘密的地下，是字面意义上的地下。

lines.en: : Also, my blood type is A- and I have a pet alligator who killed Clarissa’s dog three years ago, which started our rivalry.
lines.zh: : 还有，我的血型是 A- 型，我养了一只短吻鳄，三年前咬死了 Clarissa 的狗，我们的恩怨就是从那时开始的。

lines.en: : Why is my dog dead now?!
lines.zh: : 我的狗怎么又死了？！

lines.en: : Wow. Dating is awesome.
lines.zh: : 哇。约会真棒。

lines.en: : Alternatively, I can just be Sensei and we can have a normal conversation before Futaba’s face gets any redder and she winds up fainting.
lines.zh: : 或者，我也可以就当 Sensei，我们正常聊会儿天，免得 Futaba 的脸再红下去最后晕过去。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate7
: Aww. I already miss Frank. He always had so much to say.
lines.zh: : 呜哇。我已经开始想念 Frank 了。他总是有那么多话要说。

lines.en: : I...appreciate you switching back to your normal self...but we still don’t have to call it a double-date...
lines.zh: : 我……很感激你变回平时的自己……可我们还是不用管这叫双重约会吧……

lines.en: : You can just sit next to me like you normally do and...we can watch these two be...girlfriend and girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你就像平常那样坐我旁边就好……然后我们看着这两个人当……女朋友和女朋友。

lines.en: : What? Now I’m not good enough for you?
lines.zh: : 什么？现在我就配不上你了？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate8
: Y-You know that’s not it! I just don’t want you feeling pressured to...do something like that just so I can...fit in...
lines.zh: : 你、你明知道不是那样！我只是不想让你觉得有压力，非得……为了让我……合群……而去做那种事……

lines.en: : Hah...
scene otohadoubledate9
: I’m not doing this so you can “fit in.” I’m doing it because it changes literally nothing and doesn’t bother me.
lines.zh: : 我做这个不是为了让你们「合群」。我做这个是因为它实际上什么都不会改变，而且我也不介意。

lines.en: : So unless it bothers you for some reason, what’s the harm in just temporarily assuming the roles of people who are dating for the duration of a conversation or two?
lines.zh: : 所以除非你有什么理由介意，否则在一两段对话的时间里暂时扮演一下正在交往的人，又有什么坏处呢？

lines.en: : Weird to say this, but I’m on Sensei’s side.
lines.zh: : 说这话有点怪，但我站 Sensei 这边。

lines.en: : Just go along with it, Futaba. It’s not like you two are actually dating or anything.
lines.zh: : 就顺着来吧，Futaba。反正你们俩又不是真的在交往什么的。

lines.en: : It’s just a fun way to make you not the third wheel anymore while also making things a little less awkward for Rin and me.
lines.zh: : 这只是个好玩的法子，既能让你不再当电灯泡，又能让 Rin 和我之间的气氛不那么尴尬。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate10
: Wait, are things awkward?! What did I do wrong?!
lines.zh: : 等等，气氛尴尬吗？！我做错什么了？！

lines.en: : Huh? No...nothing. I’m just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 哈？不……没有。我只是……我不知道。

lines.en: : It’s still kind of embarrassing...holding hands and stuff in public.
lines.zh: : 在公共场合牵手什么的……还是有点难为情……

lines.en: : Awkward probably wasn’t the right word. Just...new?
lines.zh: : 「尴尬」大概不是恰当的词。就是……新鲜？

lines.en: : Is it because of my glove? I’ll take off the glove.
lines.zh: : 是因为我的手套吗？那我把手套摘了。

lines.en: : I don’t think the glove is the problem, Rin...
lines.zh: : 我觉得问题不在手套上，Rin……

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate11
: I think it’s...normal for people to feel a little awkward right after they start dating...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……刚开始交往的人有点不自在是很正常的……

lines.en: : I’ll say. You felt awkward before even temporarily dating Frank and now he’s gone forever.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛。你甚至在还没临时跟 Frank 交往之前就已经不自在了，而现在他永远地离开了。

lines.en: : I just mean that it’s...not your fault...
lines.zh: : 我只是想说……那不是你的错……

lines.en: : And...I guess now I understand a little better why we were trying to make this into a double date rather than just a normal conversation.
lines.zh: : 而且……我想我现在稍微明白一点，为什么我们要把它弄成双重约会，而不是就正常聊个天了。

lines.en: : I want to agree but, honestly, all I can think about is Otoha’s hand.
lines.zh: : 我也想认同，但说实话，我满脑子只有 Otoha 的手。

lines.en: : I was expecting a firm grip, but she actually feels really dainty and fragile.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为会是很有力的一握，结果她的手其实特别纤细柔弱。

lines.en: : That’s...probably just the glove getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 那……大概是手套碍事了吧。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate12
: Ah! So it was the glove after all!
lines.zh: : 啊！原来真的是手套的问题！

lines.en: : I’m sure I sound like a broken record in saying this again, but...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我知道我再说一遍就像个坏掉的复读机，可是……对不起。

lines.en: : No need to apologize when it’s become overwhelmingly apparent that you are the glue holding this table together right now.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉，现在明摆着的事实是，你就是眼下把这张桌子黏在一起的那个人。

lines.en: : I’m really not...I’m just hanging out with my friend and her new girlfriend...
lines.zh: : 我真的不是……我只是跟我的朋友和她的女朋友一起玩……

lines.en: : And I guess my...my...
lines.zh: : 还有我那个……我的……
: 我的……

lines.en: : Temporary boyfriend?
lines.zh: : 临时男朋友？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate13
: Umm...y-yeah...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是、是啊……

lines.en: : Which sounds weird to say even if it’s just temporary...
lines.zh: : 就算只是临时的，说出口也怪怪的……

lines.en: Futaba begins lightly tapping one of her legs underneath the table, which I’m pretty sure is a telltale sign of nervousness.
lines.zh: Futaba 开始在桌子底下轻轻点着一条腿，我很确定那是很典型的紧张表现。

lines.en: I wouldn’t normally point that out or, perhaps, even notice it. But it’s currently causing a very apparent jiggle in her chest region that I would cite as a particularly crucial element to this scenario.
lines.zh: 我平时不会去指出来，甚至可能压根注意不到。但它目前正在她胸口区域引起一阵非常明显的晃动，我会把这称为当下这个局面里尤其关键的一个要素。

lines.en: Boobs are so cool.
lines.zh: 胸部真是太棒了。

lines.en: : So...is it an official unofficial double date? Has Futaba accepted Frank-Sensei’s tentative confession?
lines.zh: : 那么……这就是一场官方的非官方双重约会了吗？Futaba 接受 Frank-Sensei 那试探性的告白了吗？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate14
: Um...y-yeah...I...accept...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是、是的……我……接受……

lines.en: : Just don’t cry when you inevitably have to break up when he leaves the table.
lines.zh: : 等他离开桌子、你们不可避免地要分手的时候，别哭就行。

lines.en: : I will...try not to.
lines.zh: : 我……会尽量不哭的。

lines.en: : Or just date for real. There’s always that.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆真的交往算了。总有这条路可以走。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate15
: Uhh...Rin?
lines.zh: : 呃……Rin？

lines.en: : What? If you two just dated for real, you wouldn’t have to actually break up when he leaves the table.
lines.zh: : 怎么？如果你们俩真的交往了，他离开桌子的时候你们就不用真的分手了。

lines.en: : Otoha even said it earlier. If there’s anyone who it would be totally cool for Sensei to date, it would be you.
lines.zh: : Otoha 之前也说过。如果说有谁跟 Sensei 交往是百分之百没问题的，那就是你。

lines.en: : I mean...that’s a little different from how I said it.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我说的跟这个有点出入。

lines.en: : I...understand that...but I don’t really think now is the best time to talk about that...
lines.zh: : 我……明白……但我真觉得现在不是谈这个的最好时机……

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate16
: Is there ever going to be a better time than right now?
lines.zh: : 还会有比现在更好的时机吗？

lines.en: : You look adorable. Sensei is in a good mood. The setting is romantic. And Nodoka’s not even here to make things weird.
lines.zh: : 你看起来可爱极了。Sensei 心情很好。气氛很浪漫。而且 Nodoka 甚至不在这儿，不会把事情搞得怪怪的。

lines.en: : You know I’m here, right? Because it’s a little weird hearing you strategize about turning this into a real relationship when I’m a part of the conversation.
lines.zh: : 你们知道我在这儿对吧？听你们策划着把这变成一段真正的恋爱关系，而我本人就在这段对话里，这感觉有点怪。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate17
: Hahah...how many times have I apologized tonight?...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……我今晚到底道了多少次歉了？……

lines.en: : I’m not sure, but I’m assuming you’re tacking another one on now.
lines.zh: : 我不确定，但我猜你现在又要再加一次了。

lines.en: : Sensei, you think Futaba is pretty, right?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你觉得 Futaba 很漂亮，对吧？

lines.en: : Why not just make it official and actually get together with her? That way, we could have real double dates all the time and not have to pretend anymore.
lines.zh: : 为什么不干脆把关系定下来，真的跟她在一起呢？那样我们就能一直有真正的双重约会，也不用再装了。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate18
: Rin...what are you doing?...
lines.zh: : Rin……你在干什么啊？……

lines.en: : Yeah, what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 对啊，怎么了？

lines.en: : I realize I’m the one who started this, but don’t you think you might be taking things a little too far?
lines.zh: : 我知道是我在开头挑起的，可你不觉得自己有点做过头了吗？

lines.en: : How? By trying to get two of my favorite people together? Is that a...weird thing for me to want?
lines.zh: : 怎么做过头了？想让我最喜欢的两个人在一起？我想要这个，很……奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...please excuse us for a moment...
lines.zh: : Sensei……请让我们单独待一会儿……

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. We don’t have to break up yet, but if anyone asks, I’m-
lines.zh: : 呃……好。我们还不用分手，不过要是有人问起来，我——

lines.en: : A minute please, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 给我一分钟，Sensei……

lines.en: : Right. Got it.
lines.zh: : 好。明白了。

lines.en: scene black
I back away from the table and wonder why two consecutive groups with seemingly infallible friendships have started combating one another over spontaneous, trivial blips in the radar that is life.
lines.zh: 我从桌边退开，心里纳闷为什么两个看起来友谊牢不可破的圈子，会开始因为人生雷达上那些自发又琐碎的小波澜而互相较劲。

lines.en: Then I go talk to Molly because she is currently drinking all by herself and her thighs look particularly alluring tonight.
lines.zh: 然后我去找 Molly 说话了，因为她现在正一个人喝酒，而她的大腿今晚看起来格外诱人。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate19
: What are you doing? Why are you putting us on the spot like that?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？你干嘛要把我们架在那儿？

lines.en: : I wasn’t trying to put you on the spot. I just...like you guys and...
lines.zh: : 我不是想把你们架在那儿。我只是……喜欢你们，而且……

lines.en: : And you like Sensei, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 而且你喜欢 Sensei，对吧？

lines.en: : Like, what if the only thing that’s preventing you two from getting together is the fact that you haven’t tried asking him out yet?
lines.zh: : 我是说，万一唯一阻碍你们俩在一起的事，就是你还没试过约他出去呢？

lines.en: : That’s...still not your place to get involved.
lines.zh: : 那……也轮不到你来掺和。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate20
: I just wanna help! Is that really so bad?
lines.zh: : 我只是想帮忙！这真的很糟糕吗？

lines.en: : When you’re forcing it down our throats, yes. Yes, it is bad, Rin.
lines.zh: : 当你硬把这些往我们嘴里塞的时候，是的。是的，很糟糕，Rin。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate21
: Even if she does like him, we can’t be that direct, dude.
lines.zh: : 就算她真的喜欢他，我们也不能这么直接啊，姐妹。

lines.en: : It’s fine to make jokes and try to push them a little closer together, but when you’re literally listing the reasons they should date, it’s...different.
lines.zh: : 开开玩笑、试着把他们推得更近一点没问题，可当你真的开始一条条列举他们该交往的理由，那就……不一样了。

lines.en: : It stops becoming a joke and...well, makes shit weird.
lines.zh: : 它就不再是个玩笑了，而且……嗯，会让事情变得很怪。

lines.en: : We can’t put Futaba in an uncomfortable position like that.
lines.zh: : 我们不能让 Futaba 陷入那种不舒服的处境。

lines.en: : But...that’s not what I...
lines.zh: : 可是……我不是那个……

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate22
: Is...Is everything okay with you right now, Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin，你现在……一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean “Okay?” I look normal, right? I’m acting normal, right?
lines.zh: : 「还好」是什么意思？我看上去很正常吧？我的表现很正常吧？

lines.en: : You look fine, but...
lines.zh: : 你看起来是挺好的，不过……

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate23
: Do you want to go? We can leave if you want.
lines.zh: : 你想走吗？你想走我们就走。

lines.en: : I don’t really know the...signs of your depression yet, but if you’re not feeling well-
lines.zh: : 我还不太清楚你抑郁的……征兆是什么，但如果你觉得不舒服——

lines.en: : What are you guys talking about? I’m totally fine. I’m just trying to help everyone out.
lines.zh: : 你们在说什么啊？我完全没事。我只是想帮大家一把。

lines.en: : You’re sure it’s not anything else?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是别的什么？

lines.en: : I...yeah! Yeah, of course! What else would it even be?
lines.zh: : 我……是啊！当然确定！还能是什么啊？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate24
: I’m sorry if I...falsely assumed something was wrong...but you can’t be saying things like that, Rin. I need to...handle stuff like this on my own.
lines.zh: : 如果我……误以为出了什么事，那我很抱歉……但你不该说那种话，Rin。这种事我得……自己处理。

lines.en: : I just...don’t want you to get overwhelmed...
lines.zh: : 我只是……不想让你被压垮……

lines.en: : I think you’re great and that...you deserve all of the love in the world.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很棒，而且……你配得上这世上所有的爱。

lines.en: : I was just trying to...I don’t know, funnel some of it into you?
lines.zh: : 我只是想……我不知道，把其中一些分给你？

lines.en: : Just...
: Let’s just treat this like any other night, okay?
lines.zh: : 我们就像平常任何一晚那样过，好吗？

lines.en: : No talk about...double dates or...romance or anything...
lines.zh: : 不谈……双重约会，也不谈……恋爱什么的……

lines.en: if futabahalloween2win == True:
: But...Futaba...
lines.zh: : 可是……Futaba……

lines.en: : He literally chose you out of everyone earlier.
lines.zh: : 他之前可是从所有人里选了你啊。

lines.en: : You have a real shot right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在真的有机会。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate25
: I don’t have any more of a shot right now than I did yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我现在的机会不比昨天多。

lines.en: : Or last week or...any other day.
lines.zh: : 也不比上周、或者……任何一天多。

lines.en: : Sensei’s...really nice to me. And yes, I do like him.
lines.zh: : Sensei……对我真的很好。是的，我确实喜欢他。

lines.en: : But...he’s not ever going to date me, Rin.
lines.zh: : 可是……他永远不会跟我交往的，Rin。

lines.en: : Don’t say that...You don’t know that...
lines.zh: : 别那么说……你又不知道……

lines.en: : If something changes, you’ll be the first to know.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么变化，你会是第一个知道的。

lines.en: : But right now...I’m happy with the way things are.
lines.zh: : 但现在……我对现状很满意。

lines.en: : I’m happy just knowing that the person I admire looks at me and doesn’t immediately compare me to either of you.
lines.zh: : 光是知道我崇拜的那个人看着我的时候，不会立刻拿我跟你俩中的任何一个比较，我就已经很满足了。

lines.en: : That’s honestly...more than I ever expected to get.
lines.zh: : 说真的……这比我曾经奢望过的都多。

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate26
: And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: : And I don’t want him getting scared away...
lines.zh: : 而且我不想把他吓跑……

lines.en: : Futaba...No...I...
lines.zh: : Futaba……不……我……

lines.en: : Anyone who would ever get scared away from you doesn’t deserve to even breathe the same air, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 任何一个会被你吓跑的人，都根本不配和你呼吸同一片空气，Futaba。

lines.en: : You’re amazing and we’ll stop with all of the double date stuff.
lines.zh: : 你很了不起，我们不会再搞什么双重约会的破事了。

lines.en: : And...we’re sorry.
lines.zh: : 还有……我们很抱歉。

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: else:
scene otohadoubledate27
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : We’ll stop everything right now. And we’re sorry for pushing things a little too far.
lines.zh: : 我们现在就全停。抱歉我们把事情推得有点过头了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Otoha……

lines.en: : I’m really sorry, Futaba...I don’t really know what got into me...
lines.zh: : 我真的很抱歉，Futaba……我也不知道自己是怎么了……

lines.en: : It’s okay, Rin. Just...please be more careful about the things you say sometimes.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Rin。只是……以后说话有时候多注意一点。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohadoubledate28
: Everything okay over here? No shattered remnants of broken bonds or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 这边一切都好吗？没有什么破碎羁绊的残骸之类的吧？

lines.en: : Nothing of the sort...Everything is fine.
lines.zh: : 完全没有那种东西……一切都很好。

lines.en: : Sorry shit got all weird. I’ll take the blame since it was all pretty much my idea.
lines.zh: : 抱歉事情变得这么怪。毕竟基本都是我的主意，这个锅我来背。

lines.en: : Let’s just...hang out or whatever and talk about completely unrelated stuff. Like...movies or...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我们就……随便玩玩什么的，聊点完全不相干的事。比如……电影或者……呃……

lines.en: : Has anyone else watched Squid Game yet?
lines.zh: : 你们有人看过《鱿鱼游戏》了吗？

lines.en: scene otohadoubledate29
: Oh my God. It was so good, right?!
lines.zh: : 哦我的天。特别好看对吧？！

lines.en: : Right?!?! And that part with the glass bridge? Wild. Absolutely fucking wild.
lines.zh: : 对吧？！？还有玻璃桥那段？疯了。真是他妈的疯了。

lines.en: scene black
The conversation carries on for another ten minutes before I finally decide it’s in my best interest to just leave.
lines.zh: 对话又持续了十分钟，最后我终于认定，走人才是最符合我利益的选择。

lines.en: Not only did I not have anything to contribute to their extremely emphatic discussion about some Korean television show, but I had a creeping suspicion that my presence was causing Rin to feel...off.
lines.zh: 不光是因为我对她们那场关于某部韩国电视剧的极度热烈的讨论毫无贡献，还因为我隐隐觉得，我的存在让 Rin 感到……不自在。

lines.en: That could just be me being self-centered, though.
lines.zh: 不过那也可能只是我太自我中心了。

lines.en: I guess it’s equally probable that her sudden swap to silence had absolutely nothing to do with me and was just the result of realizing she’d disappointed a friend.
lines.zh: 我猜她突然陷入沉默，也完全有可能跟我一点关系都没有，只是因为她意识到自己让朋友失望了。

lines.en: Futaba recovered well, though.
lines.zh: 不过 Futaba 恢复得很好。

lines.en: I would have been uncomfortable in her position too.
lines.zh: 我要是处在她的位置，也会很不舒服。

lines.en: Hell, I was uncomfortable in my position- but that was moreover because I was worried I’d have to explain to yet another girl why I don’t want to date them.
lines.zh: 操，我自己那个位置就已经够不舒服了——不过那更多是因为我担心自己又得向另一个女生解释为什么我不想跟她交往。

lines.en: That crisis was averted in its entirety, though.
lines.zh: 不过那场危机被彻底化解了。

lines.en: And now?
lines.zh: 那么现在呢？

lines.en: I must return to the drunk girl in an extremely tight dress to make sure she does not drink herself into a coma.
lines.zh: 我必须回到那个穿着紧身裙的醉酒女孩身边，确保她不会把自己喝到昏迷。

Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
lines.zh: Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!
